message.content: {"summary": "Test the supply path with an electrical load test after a reported instrument cluster blank-out following a battery recharge on a vehicle not driven daily.", "rationale": "The narrative reports that after starting, the instrument cluster went blank and displayed neither speedometer nor fuel gauge, on a vehicle whose battery had been recharged because it is not driven daily. That charging condition matches the rulebook entry 'charging', which states that charging and high-current loads stress the supply path, connectors and protection circuits and names the Electrical load test. The owner associated the event with NHTSA Campaign 13V483000, but the VIN was not included in that recall, so the campaign does not cover this vehicle and the supply-path load test is the applicable check.", "group": "ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL (ESC)", "symptoms": ["instrument cluster went blank after starting the vehicle", "speedometer not displayed", "fuel gauge not displayed"], "conditions": ["charging", "vehicle not driven daily", "battery recently recharged"], "fault_codes": [], "safety_relevant": false, "targeted": true, "test_name": "Electrical load test", "clues": [{"kind": "symptom", "quote": "the instrument cluster went blank and failed to display the speedometer or fuel gauge"}, {"kind": "condition", "quote": "after starting the vehicle"}, {"kind": "condition", "quote": "the battery was recharged due to the vehicle not being driven daily"}, {"kind": "other", "quote": "NHTSA Campaign Number: 13V483000"}, {"kind": "other", "quote": "the VIN was not included in the recall"}]}
message.reasoning_content:
The rulebook matched "charging" with "Electrical load test". But the symptom is instrument cluster blank. Conditions matched charging. Targeted test: Electrical load test.

Safety: cluster blank while driving could be risk, but narrative says after starting, parked. No explicit risk to people. safety_relevant false.

Quotes must be verbatim from case narrative. Note extraction quotes come from narrative but narrative text: "The contact stated that after starting the vehicle, the instrument cluster went blank and failed to display the speedometer or fuel gauge." Good.

Quotes: "the instrument cluster went blank and failed to display the speedometer or fuel gauge", "after starting the vehicle", "the battery was recharged due to the vehicle not being driven daily", "NHTSA Campaign Number: 13V483000", "the VIN was not included in the recall".

Targeted true since conditions match rulebook entry.
